template.name: The Ultimate Business OS
template.description: A complete Notion workspace with 6 linked databases, a master dashboard, and everything you need to run your business from one place.
benefits: Replace 5+ tools with one unified dashboard
Track every client, project, and dollar in real-time
Never miss a deadline with smart views
See your entire business at a glance
Scale from solo to team without switching tools
whats_included: Master Dashboard with live KPI widgets
Board, Calendar, Timeline, Table & Gallery views
Custom status workflows for every database
4 bonus templates: Weekly Review, Client Onboarding, Meeting Notes, Quarterly Planning

databases.name: Tasks
databases.description: Daily task management with priority tracking. 8 properties including Status, Priority, Project relation, Due Date, Tags, Time Estimate, and Client relation.

databases.name: Projects
databases.description: End-to-end project tracking with Timeline view. 8 properties including Status, Client relation, Deadline, Budget, Task Count rollup, Progress formula, and Category.

databases.name: Clients
databases.description: Complete CRM built into your workspace. 9 properties including Status, Email, Phone, Company, Value, Active Projects rollup, Last Contact, and Notes.

databases.name: Finance
databases.description: Track income, expenses, and profitability. 9 properties including Type, Amount, Date, Category, Client & Project relations, Payment Method, and Receipt files.

databases.name: Content
databases.description: Plan your entire content calendar. 8 properties including Status, Platform, Project relation, Publish Date, Word Count, URL, and Tags.

databases.name: Goals
databases.description: Quarterly and annual goal tracking. 8 properties including Timeframe, Status, Target Date, Measurable Outcome, Progress %, Related Projects, and Priority.

linked_databases: Tasks → Projects: Link every task to its parent project
Tasks → Clients: See all tasks per client
Projects → Clients: Track every project per client
Finance → Clients: Revenue and expenses by client
Finance → Projects: Budget tracking per project
Content → Projects: Content calendar aligned with projects
Goals → Projects: Ensure projects drive real goals
features: 9 Custom View Types (Board, Calendar, Timeline, Table, List, Gallery)
Automated Rollups for Task Counts and Revenue
template.delivery: Instant download - PDF guide with Notion template link
